author: Zegita
body:
I believe this was an unnessecary act by Iron as I was spectating a game between Apollo and Ethernal Cross and then midway I get kicked because I was not allowed to spectate however I was INVITED to come and spectate. I did not do any harm to anybody I was just there watching the game and then I get kicked I mean come on why was that necessary?

I just wanted to spectate the match and I was recording it because I thought it would benefit both teams to see how well they both did against each other :/. Furthermore, like I said I did NO HARM in the chat or to any teams. I did not provoke anybody I just wanted to see how both teams play as they are both good teams :/

I do want this infraction to be removed as well because I haven't done anything wrong and it will make me look bad for something I didn't do on PURPOSE nor ACCIDENTAL.
